name: qht-influencer-manager
description: QHT multi-level influencer management (Admin -> Head Influencer -> Influencer)

scripts.icons: node scripts/prepare-logo.mjs && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/android-icons.mjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/stamp-sw.mjs && npx wrangler pages deploy
scripts.deploy:schema: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply qht-influencer --remote
scripts.deploy:list: npx wrangler pages deployment list --project-name qht-influencer
scripts.deploy:log: npx wrangler pages deployment tail --project-name qht-influencer
